about: rentAfterUnitChange cases run by functions-tenant-lifecycle (moveOutTenantFields.test.ts) and the app (test/tenant_delete_guard_test.dart). Units are [unitNumber, monthlyRate]. Change the rule on one side, change the other and add a case here.

cases.name: the sum rule holds: the freed unit comes off
cases.notice: Monthly rent is now $150.00 for unit 102.

cases.name: one rate for two units (from before the rule): left alone, and the owner is asked to check
cases.notice: Check Ada Park's rent: they now hold unit 102; their rent is $100.00.

cases.name: a rate that already is the rest: left alone, nothing to check
the sum rule holds: an added unit's rate is added
cases.notice: Monthly rent is now $250.00 for units 101 and 102.

cases.name: a prorated first month is not the sum: nothing added, check
cases.notice: Check Ada Park's rent: they now hold units 101 and 102; their rent is $35.00.

cases.name: a first unit for a tenant at 0 sets it
cases.notice: Monthly rent is now $80.00 for unit 7.

cases.name: a first unit for a tenant with another rate: check
cases.notice: Check Ada Park's rent: they now hold unit 7; their rent is $100.00.

cases.name: a first unit at the tenant's rate: nothing to do
never 0 while they hold a unit
cases.notice: Check Ada Park's rent: they now hold unit 102; their rent is $100.00.

cases.name: rounded to the cent
cases.notice: Monthly rent is now $250.65 for units 101, 102 and 103.

cases.name: freed and added together (Edit Tenant)
cases.notice: Monthly rent is now $270.00 for units 103 and 102.

cases.name: their last unit: nothing to say, the rate is kept as history

ratesAbout: How a unit's or tenant's monthlyRate field is read, as [stored value, rate]: TenantService.rateField (and UnitModel) in the app, rateFromField in moveOutTenantFields.ts. A numeric string is its number; anything else is 0.
